notes: Original catalog numbers 1..96 preserved for provenance. The active 94 are NOT renumbered; 57 and 96 are absent by retirement.
postseason_eligible is null on every row pending the approved fixed 32-definition postseason subset, which was not located. Do not infer.
metric_expression is a declarative settlement basis, not implementation code.
Blocked COMPOSITE definitions carry metric_expression null by design. Formulas must not be invented.

Rev1.0 inherited rollover eligibility from FR-6_1_CATALOG_CLASSIFICATION.md section markings — §1 Milestone & Achievement (12) plus §12 Binary Qualifier Pools (7) — while evaluator_family was later assigned by bet shape. The two classifications were never reconciled. #84 and #87 are QUALIFIER definitions sitting outside those two blanket-marked sections and were left non-rollover. Rev1.1 reconciles rollover eligibility to evaluator family by explicit product ruling: RANK_EXTREMUM is never rollover-eligible, QUALIFIER always is. No other active, blocked, family, threshold, eligibility, tie-rule, anti-tanking or retirement metadata changed.

Rev1.2 adopts the POR §6.2 subject-census and classification rule. That rule is family-uniform and census-driven, so no per-definition field was added: no empty_result_behavior, no completeness threshold, no family-specific or definition-specific override. All 94 definition objects and the retired block are byte-identical to pool_catalog_rev1_1.json. Only artifact, revision, governing_spec and this note changed.
